status: METHOD_ONLY; no physical observations or qualification

toy_and_material_stipulations_verbatim.chi_basis: Stipulated chi_star=0.94 only; not a measured value, witness or established feasible case
toy_and_material_stipulations_verbatim.material_basis: Inherited unqualified source assumptions; actual material/ratings UNKNOWN
toy_and_material_stipulations_verbatim.area: A_e=A_e0/chi_star; actual A_e and L_e UNKNOWN
toy_and_material_stipulations_verbatim.allowance_basis: Illustrative equal allocation of (1-chi_star)D0. Bounds are assumptions, not actual compliances. Anchor allowance covers the assembled S^T C_ports S including both endpoint sites, all cross terms and support effects once. It is not 0.02 at each of two sites.
toy_and_material_stipulations_verbatim.cross_site_basis: No measured decoupling assumed. Any offsite term must fit the SAME assembled anchor allowance; otherwise this stipulated condition is unestablished.
toy_and_material_stipulations_verbatim.state: Common registered tangent pretension/contact/environment/history state required; actual registration UNKNOWN

mass_pool_verbatim: ONE stipulated symbolic C-U/chi pool, all34 rows and duty map unchanged; no separate anchor, fixture, support or reinforcement pool

rows.subject: Graph identity, common datum and force/displacement order
rows.prospective_observation: Register installed cord, end and site identities against the reference graph; survey attachment locations, outward directions and datum. Keep missing or ambiguous matches unresolved.
rows.falsification_or_inapplicability: Missing, duplicate or nonmatching identities, uncertain datum/sign order or an unaccounted installed member prevent using the reference graph counts for hardware.
rows.comparison_unavailable_without_evidence: Graph counts and model assembly correspondence

rows.subject: Generalized ordering, units, rotations and work-preserving transformations
rows.prospective_observation: Calibrate the full displacement/wrench channels, orientation, moment arms and datum translations. Register work-preserving transformations and any rotation scaling before projecting response.
rows.falsification_or_inapplicability: Unregistered mixed units, non-work-conjugate transformations or missing moment arms invalidate matrix comparisons even if a scalar trace looks consistent.
rows.comparison_unavailable_without_evidence: Common-basis local and global operator comparisons

rows.subject: Cord constitution, lengths/areas, construction, lot and environment

stipulated_inputs.interpretation: Inherited source strength and safety-factor assumptions, not an installed rating or newly selected threshold.

rows.prospective_observation: Use matched cord force/strain measurements and active-span/loadbearing-area metrology at registered tangent load, history and environment. Determine mass/volume density on the same traceable material/construction/lot; retain strength, creep, fatigue and temperature evidence separately. Match traceable strength/rupture and service-degradation evidence to the inherited source1050MPa/SF1.2 basis, using the registered construction, lot, effective area, terminations, load/history and environment; keep measured strength separate from tangent modulus and record the proposed margin policy explicitly.
rows.falsification_or_inapplicability: A traceable modulus or density envelope inconsistent with the stipulated properties falsifies their material applicability; missing geometry, ratings, lot/state or uncertainty leaves it unknown. A tangent modulus does not establish a strength rating. A matched applicable strength lower envelope below the inherited source rating contradicts that rating; inability to support the inherited safety-factor policy at the admitted load/state makes that use inapplicable. Missing strength, service-limit or margin evidence leaves strength applicability UNKNOWN.
rows.comparison_unavailable_without_evidence: D0 and proposed-area cord compliance; material and mass applicability

rows.subject: Both end compliances and nonaxial joint effects
rows.prospective_observation: Track cord strain separately from relative slip at each installed termination under registered incremental force. Record seating, hysteresis, creep and nonaxial translation/rotation; preserve each termination datum and shared-anchor boundary.
rows.falsification_or_inapplicability: An uncertainty upper envelope outside its allocated operator allowance rejects that allowance; demonstrated coupling or changing state prevents replacing the response by independent series scalars. An unidentified end leaves the comparison inapplicable.
rows.comparison_unavailable_without_evidence: Each end allowance and independent-series specialization

rows.subject: Full nine-direction anchor compliance, including cross terms
rows.prospective_observation: Apply independent incremental load directions spanning the registered port space and observe every port response. Retain offdiagonal terms, support response and uncertainty. Test reciprocity/passivity at the registered state before using symmetry.
rows.quantity_units: N; m; m/N; wrench and displacement units as C02
rows.falsification_or_inapplicability: Incomplete excitation/response rank, unregistered supports, unresolved offdiagonals or failure of reciprocal/passive response invalidates the assumed operator identification or its symmetry reduction. Local identification alone cannot establish global retention.
rows.comparison_unavailable_without_evidence: Full projected local anchor operator; assembled allowance needs C06

rows.subject: Coupled load transfer and complete assembly boundary
rows.prospective_observation: Register compatible edge/port/frame coordinates, constraints, internal coordinates and incidence maps. Observe coupled site/frame load paths, including crosssite responses; account for each support once and document any proposed decomposition.
rows.quantity_units: m; N; compatible operator units registered by C02
rows.falsification_or_inapplicability: Observed crosssite coupling outside the same assembled allowance, unsupported decomposition, omitted boundaries or double-counted support invalidates the connection sum. No global identification count follows solely from the local port count.
rows.comparison_unavailable_without_evidence: Assembled connection allowance and global transfer applicability

rows.subject: Pretension, tautness, contact, slack and tangent state
rows.prospective_observation: Register pretension, contact, tautness, seating, load/environment/time and history for each intended state; observe tangent changes and applicable material limits across the declared envelope.
rows.quantity_units: N; m; rad; time/environment units registered in evidence
rows.falsification_or_inapplicability: Slack, contact changes, hysteretic/nonlinear response or a state outside the demonstrated envelope prevents transferring a single tangent operator or axial constitutive law to that state.
rows.comparison_unavailable_without_evidence: Any tangent stiffness, retention or strength comparison

rows.subject: Local sufficient condition and area/compliance coupling
rows.prospective_observation: Combine registered cord/end/assembled-anchor uncertainty envelopes in the same basis and state. Compare with the existing symbolic sufficient condition using the measured geometry and proposed area; do not treat area and connection compliance as independent knobs.
rows.quantity_units: dimensionless retention; m/N in a compatible basis
rows.falsification_or_inapplicability: An upper envelope that cannot satisfy the existing connection bound rejects that sufficient-condition claim. Missing passive symmetric response, positive cord compliance, compatible basis or area/state evidence makes it inapplicable. The scalar specialization additionally needs its stated positive denominator and independent-series assumptions. Local sufficiency evidence stays in its contract-row placeholder and cannot populate global /actual/chi; the C09 registered global comparison is required.
rows.comparison_unavailable_without_evidence: Conditional local axial-network sufficiency, without global qualification

rows.subject: Global constrained sufficient condition and nullspaces
rows.prospective_observation: Register the frozen target and retained members, constraints, nullspace quotient, condensation, prestress and support state. Establish a uniform uncertainty-aware assembled lower-operator comparison over all admitted states and modes; include added-mechanism/stability evidence.
rows.quantity_units: Registered work-conjugate stiffness/energy units; dimensionless retention
rows.falsification_or_inapplicability: A deficient admitted mode, changed nullspace/constraint/state or unsupported prestress/stability/application premise invalidates the target comparison. A local pass does not populate global chi; absent uniform evidence leaves the result unknown.
rows.comparison_unavailable_without_evidence: Global retained-stiffness interpretation and reference applicability

rows.subject: Conditional4320-site applicability and confidence
rows.prospective_observation: Build a traceable coverage map by construction, lot, geometry, termination, support, state and environment. Define the intended population and confidence target before a scientifically justified variability/sampling rationale; identify every nonequivalent configuration or demonstrate a uniform envelope.
rows.falsification_or_inapplicability: An uncovered nonequivalent configuration or unsupported uniform/statistical premise prevents extrapolation. Operator identification at one state is not population confidence; specimen counts and confidence remain unknown.
rows.comparison_unavailable_without_evidence: Full installed-assembly applicability and statistical inference

rows.subject: One34-row additions pool and nonoverlapping mass ownership
rows.prospective_observation: Register itemized measured masses and duty/architecture ownership for ends, anchors, frame, supports, fixtures and other carried additions. Match replacement evidence before credits and classify laboratory-only equipment through an explicit duty decision.
rows.falsification_or_inapplicability: An omitted carried item, overlapping allocation, unsupported replacement saving or second additions pool invalidates reconciliation. Budget fit cannot be determined without complete measured inventory and the unchanged common-pool basis.
rows.comparison_unavailable_without_evidence: One-pool actual-mass reconciliation and budget applicability

rows.subject: Evidence registration, identification counts and applicability decision
rows.prospective_observation: Register prospective evidence IDs, provenance, calibration, uncertainty and coverage against the common reference. Name the intended applicability/confidence target and architecture, then assign evidence owners before any physical campaign.
rows.falsification_or_inapplicability: Untraceable evidence, unassigned owners, unspecified applicability/confidence or missing architecture choices prevent a qualification decision; instrument classes and a paper protocol are not measured evidence.

acceptance_thresholds: Only inherited symbolic conditions; new numeric thresholds, specimen counts, confidence and applicability are UNKNOWN
